messages.subject: GroupComparison Issue with DIANN data
parts:
Hi MSStats Team,

I am having some issues the GroupComparison function. The ComparisonResult within shows NA for log2FC, SE, Tvalue, etc., while the FittedModel shows NULL for all iterations. 
I made sure that the comparison matrix has been made appropriately where the T samples are the numerators while the N samples are the denominator.

Below are my code and the sessioninfo(). I'm also attaching the QC Plot of this study.

#Read in DIA-NN Report
input <- data.table::fread('report.tsv')

#Read in annotation file
annot.diann <- data.table::fread('20240126_diapasef_annotation3.csv')
colnames(annot.diann) <- c('File.Name', 'Condition','BioReplicate','Run')


#DIANN To MSStats Formating Step
quantDIA <- DIANNtoMSstatsFormat(
  input,
  annotation = annot.diann,
  global_qvalue_cutoff = 0.01,
  removeProtein_with1Feature = TRUE,
  use_log_file = TRUE,
  useUniquePeptide = TRUE,
  removeProtein_with1Peptide = TRUE,
  MBR = TRUE)

#dataProcess Step
quant.diann <- dataProcess(quantDIA,
                              logTrans=2,
                              normalization = 'equalizeMedians',
                              featureSubset = "all",
                              summaryMethod = 'TMP',
                              MBimpute=TRUE,
                              censoredInt='NA',
                              maxQuantileforCensored = 0.999)

#groupComparison
levels(quant.diann$FeatureLevelData$GROUP)
comparison1 <- matrix(c(-1,0,0,0,1,0,0,0),nrow=1)
comparison2 <- matrix(c(0,-1,0,0,0,1,0,0),nrow=1)
comparison3 <- matrix(c(0,0,-1,0,0,0,1,0),nrow=1)
comparison4 <- matrix(c(0,0,0,-1,0,0,0,1),nrow=1)
comparison<-rbind(comparison1,comparison2,comparison3,comparison4)
row.names(comparison1) <- c("T_DoubleSomatic-N_DoubleSomatic")
                            #,"T_Lynch-N_Lynch","T_Methylation-N_Methylation","T_MSS-N_MSS")
groups = levels(quant.diann$ProteinLevelData$GROUP)
colnames(comparison1) <- groups[order(as.numeric(groups))]
Lynch_Comparison <- groupComparison(contrast.matrix = comparison1,
                                                        log_base = 2,
                                                        data = quant.diann,
                                    use_log_file = TRUE,
                                    verbose = TRUE)

-Fernando "Ralph" Tobias
